name: Frontier
description: The first safe route beyond the healer's hut. Light gathering, simple hunts, and dependable supplies.

name: Quarry Edge
description: A harsher labor route with stone, ore, and heavier field work.

name: Deep Woods
description: A dangerous hunting route with beasts, abandoned camps, and stronger wilderness rewards.

name: Ancient Vault
description: A late expedition where rare equipment and guarded relics begin to appear.

name: Bandit Road
description: A hostile story route tied to bandit encounters and late-run escalation.
